items.title: Ed Allen Interview, 1961-01-14
items.q: Ranger and all. Writes and everything. He writes for some magazine in France, I think one in England too.

ctx.x: But you say there's some good men in the band, huh? Rudy Powell, did he play clarinet too, was one of the sax? Yeah. He was a wonderful saxophone. He was one of our top saxophone players, believe it or not. You wouldn't think he'd be in a squad like that.

Oh no, that's a mess. And he's played with all the name bands, Fred Wallace, Capp, Calloway, every band band, he's been with them one time or another. Does he still play any clarinet? Yeah. Very good. He's very active too. Good musicians, great. Ranger and all. Writes and everything. He writes for some magazine in France, I think one in England too. A local durn over there.

Gee, he ought to be able to make some more recordings now. Yeah, he's getting along with it. What does he do when he makes a record? He takes the night off and pays somebody to come and make a play? Some of them come and work for him.
